deals.title: Blink Wired Doorbell 2K+ & Outdoor 2K+ 5-Camera Security System for $120 + free shipping
deals.sourceText: This Blink bundle includes five outdoor cameras and a wired video doorbell for $120, down from $400. It's also the lowest price this set has hit on Amazon. All the cameras record 2K video with enhanced audio and color night vision, and the outdoor units run on battery power while the doorbell wires directly into existing doorbell wiring. Buy Now at Amazon Features Includes 5 outdoor cameras plus a wired video doorbell Records 2K video resolution with enhanced audio Night Vision captures color in low light and switches to black and white in darkness Doorbell connects through existing doorbell wiring for always-on power Outdoor cameras run on battery for months per charge Weather-resistant IP-65 design withstands rain and dust
